chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly hagiographic-travel narrative and dialogue frame about Mani’s mission under Shapur and opposition in various lands, with exhortation and church language near the end. It lacks the impersonal, systematic cosmological-correspondential structures (numbered maps, body↔cosmos correlations, etc.) that mark the oldest teaching layer. Several phrases echo Jn 3 (‘world loves darkness…hates light’), indicating Christian overlay, and multiple dialogue attributions (‘our enlightener…’, ‘the apostle speaks…’) confirm compilation-frame composition rather than pre-compilation teaching.
